# Fetch all friends pages
all_friends = []
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
while True:
    page = apis.venmo.search_friends(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    all_friends.extend(page)
    if len(page) < page_limit:
        break
    page_index += 1

# Count friends made since start of October last year (2022-10-01)
from datetime import datetime
start_date = datetime(2022, 10, 1)
count = 0
for friend in all_friends:
    friends_since = datetime.fromisoformat(friend['friends_since'])
    if friends_since >= start_date:
        count += 1
print(count)
